relationships.subject: melatonin
relationships.evidence_quote: Melatonin had potent analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects in SNL-induced neuropathic pain via NF-κB/NLRP3 inflammasome signaling pathway.

relationships.subject: melatonin
relationships.evidence_quote: We observed an SNL-induced upregulation of TNF-α, IL-18, IL-1β, NLRP3, ASC, cleaved caspase-1, and NF-κB in the lumbar spinal cord horn of rats, which was significantly attenuated by intraperitoneal injection of melatonin or VX-765.

relationships.subject: melatonin
relationships.evidence_quote: The results showed that melatonin treatment alleviated SNL-induced allodynia.

relationships.subject: 4P-PDOT
relationships.evidence_quote: co-treatment of melatonin and 4P-PDOT abrogated the analgesic and anti-inflammatory effect of melatonin

key_findings: Melatonin alleviated SNL allodynia and reduced spinal TNF-alpha, IL-18, IL-1beta, NLRP3, ASC, cleaved caspase-1 and NF-kB.
The MT2 antagonist 4P-PDOT abrogated melatonin's effects.
